payload.reason: The evidence provides sufficient information about the performance of multilingual BERT (M-Bert) in various settings, including cross-lingual and cross-target tasks.

claims.text: M-Bert performs better than majority class baselines in cross-lingual and cross-target settings, although it shows a drop in performance compared to supervised settings.
M-Bert demonstrates some capability for zero-shot transfer to unseen languages and targets, but there is room for improvement in performance.
The model achieves reasonable accuracy on the x-stance dataset, comparable to previous benchmarks, but shows a performance drop of 6-8 percentage points in cross-lingual settings.
